title: Routine health checkups for senior citizens
summary: Regular checkups help older adults notice blood pressure, blood sugar, vision, hearing, and mobility changes early. Ask a qualified clinician which tests are suitable. This is general awareness, not a diagnosis.
warning_signs: Sudden weakness on one side of the body
when_to_seek_help: Book a clinic visit for routine screening as advised by a doctor
Seek urgent care for chest pain, trouble breathing, or loss of consciousness

title: Heat and hydration for farmers
summary: Farm work in high heat raises the risk of heat exhaustion. Rest in shade, drink water often, and avoid the hottest hours when possible. Do not use unprescribed medicines or salt tablets without medical advice.
warning_signs: Dizziness, heavy sweating, or nausea while working in heat
when_to_seek_help: Move to a cooler place and sip water if you feel unwell in the heat
Call local emergency services if someone becomes unconscious or stops sweating and feels extremely hot

title: Eye care for students
summary: Long reading and screen time can strain the eyes. Use good lighting, take short breaks, and get vision checked if you squint, have headaches, or cannot see the board clearly. An eye-care professional should decide any treatment.
warning_signs: Seeing flashes of light or many new floaters
when_to_seek_help: Visit an optometrist or ophthalmologist for blurred vision that does not settle with rest
Seek urgent care for sudden vision loss or severe eye pain

title: When to seek urgent help
summary: Some symptoms need emergency care at once. Do not wait for an app or a relative to decide. Call local emergency services if someone may be having a heart attack, stroke, severe breathing trouble, or is unconscious.
warning_signs: Sudden weakness, facial droop, or trouble speaking
when_to_seek_help: Call local emergency services immediately for severe symptoms
Stay with the person until trained help arrives

title: Safe water and monsoon hygiene
summary: Flooded or unclean water can spread stomach infections. Use safe drinking water, wash hands with soap, and keep food covered. Seek care if vomiting, high fever, or severe diarrhoea occurs, especially in children and older adults.
warning_signs: Very little urine or extreme thirst
when_to_seek_help: See a clinician for persistent vomiting or diarrhoea
Seek urgent care for signs of severe dehydration

title: Blood pressure awareness for older adults
summary: High blood pressure often has no obvious symptoms. Periodic measurement at a clinic or health centre can help a doctor decide next steps. Never start, stop, or change medicine based on this summary.
when_to_seek_help: Ask a qualified clinician how often to check blood pressure
Call emergency services for chest pain, fainting, or stroke-like symptoms

title: Hearing and balance in later life
summary: Hearing loss and unsteadiness are common as people age and can increase fall risk. A clinician can check hearing and balance. Home remedies and unprescribed drops are not a substitute for care.
when_to_seek_help: Ask a doctor or audiologist about a hearing check
Seek urgent care after a fall with head injury or sudden hearing loss

title: Pesticide handling awareness for farmers
summary: Follow label instructions from licensed products and wear recommended protection. Wash hands and clothes after spraying. This topic does not recommend any chemical or dose.
warning_signs: Burns on skin from chemical contact
when_to_seek_help: Move to fresh air and remove contaminated clothing if exposure occurs
Call local emergency services for breathing trouble, seizures, or unconsciousness
